title: For each completed migration, show the migration id, status, source compute
question: For each completed migration, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current migration and the next 2 migrations (ordered by migration id), along with the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following migrations (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.status,
    m.source_compute,
    m.dest_compute,
    m.dest_host,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    MAX(b.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY b.migration_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb,
    AVG(b.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY b.status ORDER BY b.migration_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  w.migration_id,
  w.status,
  w.source_compute,
  w.dest_compute,
  w.dest_host,
  w.display_name,
  w.vm_state,
  w.max_memory_mb,
  w.memory_mb,
  s.`key` AS system_metadata_key,
  s.value AS system_metadata_value,
  w.avg_memory_mb
FROM win w
LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = w.instance_uuid
ORDER BY w.migration_id;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.status,
    m.source_compute,
    m.dest_compute,
    m.dest_host,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    MAX(b.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY b.migration_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb,
    AVG(b.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY b.status ORDER BY b.migration_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_memory_mb
  FROM base b
)
SELECT
  w.migration_id,
  w.status,
  w.source_compute,
  w.dest_compute,
  w.dest_host,
  w.display_name,
  w.vm_state,
  w.max_memory_mb,
  w.memory_mb,
  s.`key` AS system_metadata_key,
  s.value AS system_metadata_value,
  w.avg_memory_mb
FROM win w
LEFT JOIN instance_system_metadata s ON s.instance_uuid = w.instance_uuid
ORDER BY w.migration_id;
